verdict.rationale: Expensify docs mention 'Smart Limits on cards' and 'multi-level GL coding' which suggest some card-limit and budget-tracking capability, but there is no evidence of a feature to allocate budgets specifically to teams/projects or of approval workflows that enforce those allocations. missing for 10: team/project-level budget allocation, documented approval-workflow enforcement tied to budgets, independent verification that Smart Limits actually block overspend in practice.
